metadata.reportTitle: AntiFan — Hoplongtech 15-Page Clone Storefront Haravan Fidelity Campaign Matrix

criticalRoutingInvariants: Silent Fallback Trap: Haravan storefront returns HTTP 200 for invalid/non-existent theme IDs (e.g. 999999) but serves assets from live production theme (1001510509). Verifier MUST inspect rendered asset URLs to assert they match /1001512581/.
Never mutate or push to live theme 1001510509. All writes strictly confined to theme copy 1001512581.
Zero external hotlinks: no visual requests (images, fonts, stylesheets) may hit reference domains (hoplongtech.com, hoplong.com, img.hoplongtech.com).

failModes.name: Mobile Structural Parity Mismatch (Geometry Drift > 2px)
failModes.description: On mobile viewport (390px), clone rendered with tiny pixel diff (0.01% mismatch) but document height differed by 10px from reference (e.g. 4270px ref vs 4280px clone). Because maxGeometryDeltaPx is strictly 2px in computeStructuralMetrics, geometryWithinTolerance evaluated to false. By Structural Primacy invariant, structural failure overrides low visual diff, forcing verdictMatch=false and producing FAIL with causeCode STRUCTURAL_PARITY_MISMATCH.
failModes.rootCause: Padding/margin box calculation divergence on mobile elements (likely header/footer or viewport auto-scaling in mobile container adding 10px vertical height).
failModes.remediation: Audit and align mobile root container CSS padding, margin, and border-box sizing to eliminate the 10px vertical drift.

failModes.name: Cross-Domain CMS/Elementor Layout & Animation Divergence (hoplong.com)
failModes.description: Pages 12-15 originate from hoplong.com (WordPress Elementor architecture) rather than hoplongtech.com. They rely on complex CSS keyframe animations, scroll-triggered milestones (Page 13 timeline: 8643px height, 74.57% mismatch), dynamic job accordions (Pages 14-15), and Inter font typography. When extracted and localized, dynamic Elementor runtime states and animations did not settle identically, yielding massive pixel mismatches (24.83% to 74.57%).
failModes.rootCause: Elementor dynamic animation scripts, scroll-reveal transitions, and uncompiled WordPress layout blocks failing to settle deterministically in static Haravan Liquid templates.
failModes.remediation: Normalize and freeze Elementor animation states; replace dynamic keyframe transforms with static layout CSS; ensure exact typography alignment (Inter font metrics).

inconclusiveModes.name: Tablet (1024px) Responsive Breakpoint Height Divergence
inconclusiveModes.description: At 1024px tablet breakpoint, reference and clone exhibit minor layout height differences (delta 15px to 120px) due to text wrapping or header/nav collapse. Because dimensionsMatch is false, comparator returned STRUCTURAL_PARITY_MISMATCH, which canonicalVerdict maps to INCONCLUSIVE.
inconclusiveModes.rootCause: Breakpoint transition rules at 1024px differing between reference CSS and clone theme CSS.
inconclusiveModes.remediation: Tune 1024px @media queries for font sizing, line-height, and container widths to achieve byte-identical document height.

inconclusiveModes.name: CDP Capture Failure & Settle Timeout / Severe Truncation
inconclusiveModes.description: On mobile 390px for Home and Cart, reference measured at 3156px while clone measured 4491px (a 1335px delta), causing CDP full-page screenshot capture or dimension validation to fail (Capture: FAIL). On P12-1024, CDP capture failed to complete within the capture budget. canonicalVerdict maps captureValid=false to INCONCLUSIVE (CAPTURE_INVALID).
inconclusiveModes.rootCause: Massive document height delta (1335px) caused by uncollapsed mobile navigation, lazy loading failure, or auth redirect modal divergence on mobile.
inconclusiveModes.remediation: Stabilize mobile lazy-loaded components and ensure full-page height settling before screenshot invocation.

inconclusiveModes.name: Structural Truncation Detected (> 10% Height Tolerance Delta)
inconclusiveModes.description: On Product Detail page (P07), RefDocH vs CloneDocH delta was -395px (11% delta) at 1440px and -618px (12.7% delta) at 390px. Because height delta exceeded the 10% effectiveHeightTolerance, comparator aborted pixel comparison with STRUCTURAL_TRUNCATION_DETECTED (100% mismatch), which maps to INCONCLUSIVE.
inconclusiveModes.rootCause: Missing specifications table rows, description tab truncation, or absent related product cards in the clone template.
inconclusiveModes.remediation: Ensure complete Liquid product template rendering including technical specification tables, reviews block, and related product grid.

inconclusiveModes.name: Complex Article & Product Content Layout Parity Mismatch
inconclusiveModes.description: On P11 (Chi tiết tin tức), article content formatting, inline images, and related articles sidebar layout diverged, causing 26.29% to 30.22% mismatch and 208px to 290px height deltas. P07-1024 had 25.93% mismatch. P09-1440 had 0.77% mismatch with 15px height delta.
inconclusiveModes.rootCause: Article body typography, inline image scaling, and sidebar wrapping differences across viewports.
inconclusiveModes.remediation: Standardize rich text article content styling, image responsive constraints, and technical document tables.
